title: Chris's 'Rosetta Stone' project to decode the phenomenon with sensors and quantum AI

tellings.quote: I think we can get actual real time communication through the light and through sensors if we can gather enough data.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says UFOs and strange lights appear around him, has a plan he calls a "Rosetta Stone" project: gather sensor data on those lights and use quantum computing and artificial intelligence to decode them. He tells Michels he believes "we can get actual real time communication through the light and through sensors if we can gather enough data." If it worked, it would mean a two-way conversation with whatever is behind the phenomenon, which he places in the years 2025 to 2030.
